description: A coupling library and ecosystem for partitioned multi-physics and multi-scale simulations, including surface and volume coupling.

latest_release.name: v3.4.1
latest_release.body:
Dear preCICE community,

We are happy to announce a new preCICE release v3.4.1.

This hotfix release resolves an issue when enabling the new Kokkos-Kernel mappings, which mistakenly required Ginkgo to be installed.

For all details, check the full list of changes in the [changelog](https://github.com/precice/precice/blob/v3.4.1/CHANGELOG.md).

Happy coupling!

> [!IMPORTANT]
> We reuploaded fixed Debian packages for Ubuntu 26.04 resolute on the 4. May.
